notes.content:
- Add Material Icons by Google 

- Replace a lot of text with icons 

- More intuitive interface

- Reduce the number of runtime librairies to avoid compatibility issues (use stb_image instead of FreeImage, stb_truetype instead of FreeType) 

- Change Windows compiler from Visual C++ to g++ 

Édgimon is still planned to be released this year: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2763090/dgimon/

notes.title: Now available on Linux
notes.content:
How could a penguin game not be available on Linux?

Well, now it is, natively, in a snap of fingers, thanks to OpenGL & cross platform audio/input libraries. 

Feel free to try this new version, and report any bugs in the forums. 

I've only tested it on Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, so there may be bugs on other Linux platforms.

notes.title: Series 4
notes.content:
To celebrate Steam sales and the arrival of new players, new content is being added to the game.

The penguin will now explore caves filled with pandas. New arrows go in reverse direction instead of rotating. 

If you bought the game, don't forget to leave a review, I read all of them. 

Gross sales $410/$1000. This milestone is required to unlock advanced Steam features, such as trading cards, profile features, and remove the limit of 100 achievements. 

Currently, the story is still To be continued. Eventually, the game will have an ending. IQ values are spread over the new levels and readjusted automatically on each update.

notes.title: Workshop feature
notes.content:
You can now create your own puzzles and share them with other players. 

To create a level: 
- On the main menu, press "Puzzle Editor". 
- To create a new folder, click the "New" button on the left and drag it. 
- To create a new puzzle, click the "New" button on the right and drag it. 
- In the "Edit" tab, you can define the tiles of the level. 
- In the "Test" tab, you can test your level. 
- In the "Workshop" tab, you can upload your level to workshop. 

To play puzzles created by other players:
- Go to the community workshop in Steam and subscribe to an item.
- On the main menu, press "Workshop Subscriptions". 
- Select the item in the top left menu.

notes.title: Series 3
notes.content:
The first 15 levels of Series 3 are available.  

On his way to the ice floe, the penguin will have to survive through a mysterious laboratory.

With pistons, grippers, portals and cloning machines, the real game can almost begin.

notes.title: Fixing bugs
notes.content: *Fixed a bug which caused the penguin to ignore arrows while getting pushed over them. Previously valid solutions may now fail.

notes.title: Series 2 + Level Editor
notes.content:
Hello,

Thank you for being an early supporter. As promised, I am upgrading my development tools to add a massive amount of content to the game. 

After the dungeon, the penguin will now have to explore a forest. 

Each serie is a new environment with unique new items and rules. Due to the difficulty of certain levels, it is not required to finish a serie to play the next one, only a fixed IQ level is required. 

I have also designed a level editing UI, that is now part of the game. 

How many series will there be? Undecided. Probably until your IQ is decent. 

To support the game, please leave a review on the store page, or feedback in the Steam discussions forum.
